summary: Operator further refined architecture: one account-wide maxConcurrentAgents across all roles/projects/devices; Manager and Lead count; scheduler itself does not. Scheduler performs non-agent global admission check and skips spawning Manager entirely at full capacity. When only one free slot remains, a terminal Manager-to-child launch token handoff lets Manager plan a role then logically yield before client submits child, preserving global cap and last-slot utilization. Role explicitly assigned when scheduler spawns Manager and Manager spawns Lead/Worker/Reviewer/Integrator; client auto-numbers concurrent same-role display instances, never durable agent IDs. Revised docs/specs/work-queues-and-ephemeral-executions.md in isolated work-queues-review-corrections: account-global Git-backed CAS capacity ledger separate from per-project task ledgers, two-ledger reconciliation without imaginary atomicity, full-capacity recovery diagnostics and release wakeups, 33 acceptance/negative-space tests, and TUI global cap display.
